correctness.rationale: For H=span{1,e^{it}}, normalized 2x2 concentration Gram matrix has diagonal a/pi and offdiagonal Z/(2pi), yielding top eigenvalue a/pi+|Z|/(2pi). Rotate by Fourier moment phase so Z=|Z|>0. Missing density inside centred arc and added density outside each have mass m, values [0,1]. Strict monotonicity of cos geodesic distance gives sharp bathtub rearrangements: missing inside contributes at least 2(sin a-sin(a-m/2)); added outside contributes at most 2(sin(a+m/2)-sin a). Thus |Z|<=2sin a(2cos(m/2)-1), yielding the exact deficit and m<2pi/3 since |Z|>0. Equality uniquely fixes both boundary caps as indicator densities, giving the explicit central arc plus two outer caps E_{a,m}; direct phase integration verifies Z>0 and realizes every geometrically feasible m. Taylor coefficient sin a/(4pi) follows. Symbolic cap integration and 200 independent 4096-grid phase-centred random soft-mask comparisons corroborate; grid tolerance is nonrigorous.
